13efac06f07c8afd.title: DNA Synthesis Platform Engineer
13efac06f07c8afd.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 
We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.
We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.
About the Role
We're looking for a hands-on scientist-engineer to help build our next-generation DNA synthesis platform, enabling high-throughput, cost-effective production of large and diverse DNA libraries. You'll work at the intersection of chemistry, materials science, bioengineering, and hardware development, designing and building prototypes, running experiments, and optimizing processes to turn new synthesis technologies into reliable, scalable production systems.
DNA synthesis is a fundamental part of our protein engineering platform. We're developing new approaches to dramatically increase synthesis throughput while reducing cost and turnaround time.
You'll work closely with our scientific and engineering teams to develop and prototype new DNA synthesis technologies. Your focus will be on translating scientific concepts into working hardware and experimental systems, designing and building prototypes, testing different approaches, and continuously improving their performance.
This is a highly hands-on, interdisciplinary role combining experimental science with practical engineering. You'll take ownership of prototype development, experimental validation, and process optimization, helping move promising technologies from early concepts to reliable, scalable systems.

**The Role: Cloud & DevSecOps Engineer**

Day to day, that means designing and running our infrastructure across Google Cloud Platform and AWS, owning our GitLab CI/CD pipelines, and implementing the security controls that protect PHI and financial data.

This role has a deliberate growth path. You will start as the hands-on engineer who builds and secures the platform. **Cloud & AI Operations | Rapid Circle**

**Run. Improve. Pioneer.**

Een incident oplossen is soms het werk.

**Zorgen dat hetzelfde incident niet nog een keer gebeurt, is waar engineering begint.**

Bij Rapid Circle werk je als Cloud Engineer aan bedrijfskritische Azure- en Microsoft 365-omgevingen. Je lost technische problemen op, voert changes uit en houdt klantomgevingen gezond. Maar daar stopt het niet.

We verwachten dat je verder kijkt.

**Waarom gebeurde dit? Wat kunnen we verbeteren? Wat kunnen we automatiseren? En kunnen we het probleem helemaal wegnemen?**

Dat is hoe wij naar Cloud & AI Operations kijken.

Als Cloud Engineer werk je hands-on met Microsoft-technologie, waaronder **Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, networking, security, Intune en automation**.

De ene dag onderzoek je een complex incident. De volgende dag voer je een change uit, verbeter je monitoring, schrijf je een PowerShell-script of werk je samen met een ervaren engineer aan een structurele verbetering van een klantomgeving.

Van handmatig reageren naar slimmer beheren.

Van steeds opnieuw oplossen naar structureel verbeteren.

Van terugkerend werk naar automatisering.

Als Cloud Engineer draag je actief bij aan die ontwikkeling. Je herkent terugkerende problemen, denkt mee over verbeteringen en krijgt de ruimte om nieuwe technologieën en werkwijzen in de praktijk toe te passen.

**Die manier van werken bouwen we nu verder uit. En daar kun jij een belangrijke bijdrage aan leveren.**

We zoeken een Cloud Engineer die niet tevreden is met:

**"Het werkt weer."**

#### **Your creative field**

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).  
  
As a Platform & Reliability Engineer at Contabo, you take architectural ownership of our shared infrastructure services – the foundation that multiple development teams build on: API gateway and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress), persistent storage (Ceph, Longhorn), secrets and identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), edge security and WAF (Cloudflare), and our observability stack. You'll be taking over grown, partially under-documented systems – and that's exactly where the appeal of this role lies: you work your way deep into these systems, identify and remediate known weak points, evaluate aging components with solution-agnostic build-vs-buy reasoning, and decide which legacy pieces get fixed, replaced, or retired.  
  
One of your central mandates: you design and establish an on-call process, including runbooks for platform and infrastructure incidents – where no formal process exists today. In parallel, you mature our observability practices, rolling out distributed tracing, SLOs/SLIs, and meaningful dashboards across the stack, building on our existing tooling with Prometheus, Grafana, Alloy, and OpenTelemetry. In system design reviews, you bring your strong grounding in the fundamentals – load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistency trade-offs – and apply them to new and existing services alike.  
  
You won't be managing a team, but you will be the technical authority multiple teams rely on: you advise across teams on shared infrastructure services, document your knowledge consistently, and actively distribute it – so that critical know-how never again depends on a single person. Success in this role means: known risks are resolved, a solid on-call process is up and running, and single points of failure are measurably reduced platform-wide. The position is remote (Germany), with hybrid or on-site work optional; occasional travel for datacenter visits and team offsites is part of the role.

#### **What convinces us**

Your personality, paired with:

  

* 7+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or SRE roles, ideally with end-to-end responsibility for a private cloud or IaaS platform

The role sits in the Infrastructure team, with our VP of Engineering as hiring manager. Your users are H's product and platform engineers and, through our FDEs, our external customers.

--------------------------

* Write Python or Go well enough to solve real problems with it
* Have built and operated a Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale and can put numbers on its clusters, services and users
* Have worked with more than one cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP), or have strong knowledge of fundamental systems engineering (Linux, eBPF)
* Have built and owned infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability

**Stronger still if you have:**

* Worked with complex network topologies (multi-cluster, dual-stack) and CNIs such as Cilium or Calico
* Handled petabyte-scale data, or high-frequency, latency-sensitive workloads
* Worked with agentic systems, particularly in security
* Worked with GPUs and tools such as Dynamo, vLLM or SGLang

**How we hire**
---------------

Five stages, about 3.5 hours in all: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 30-minute conversation with the lead of the Infrastructure team, a 60-minute coding interview, a 60-minute system design interview and a closing 30-minute conversation with our VP of Engineering.

**Practicalities**
------------------

The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Paris or London office. We offer a competitive package.

### **Meet Siena**

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

You take the hardest problems customers hit in production and solve them end to end: a webhook that stopped firing, an agent filling the wrong parameter, a report that won't reconcile. * Raise the team's floor. Lift what the whole team can resolve, not just what you can
* Know where your scope ends. Escalate genuine product bugs and outages with a clean reproduction, not a shrug
* Within 90 days, name the top recurring failure patterns and attack them at the root, not just patch symptoms

Elastic Observability is building a system that monitors production environments the way an expert SRE would: it learns what normal looks like across logs, metrics, and traces, generates its own detection queries, identifies when something meaningful changes, and launches autonomous investigations — without waiting for a human to notice first.

User-facing surfaces:
 Build the Kibana interfaces where signals, investigations, and findings reach users: the views an SRE uses to follow an investigation, inspect the evidence behind a conclusion, and drive the remediation that follows. You'll be joining the team responsible for the infrastructure behind all of H's products: clusters, networking and security. It's the foundation that lets the rest of the company deliver value directly to customers.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

From your first quarter, you'll own a real piece of our move from AWS to an environment-agnostic platform. The team moves fast and the problems are novel: each model release and each new customer changes what the infrastructure has to support.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Running and scaling Kubernetes clusters and networking
* Building authentication and authorization systems
* Refactoring the stack to be environment agnostic
* Speeding up deployment for our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)
* Building Kubernetes-native services, such as controllers and operators
* Writing and maintaining infrastructure as code

**Your team and your users**
----------------------------

The role sits in the Infrastructure team, with our VP of Engineering as hiring manager. Your users are H's product and platform engineers and, through our FDEs, our external customers.

**What we think it takes**
--------------------------

**You're likely a good fit if you:**

* Write Python or Go well enough to solve real problems with it
* Have built and operated a Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale and can put numbers on its clusters, services and users
* Have worked with more than one cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP), or have strong knowledge of fundamental systems engineering (Linux, eBPF)
* Have built and owned infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability

**Stronger still if you have:**

* Worked with complex network topologies (multi-cluster, dual-stack) and CNIs such as Cilium or Calico
* Handled petabyte-scale data, or high-frequency, latency-sensitive workloads
* Worked with agentic systems, particularly in security
* Worked with GPUs and tools such as Dynamo, vLLM or SGLang

**How we hire**
---------------

Five stages, about 3.5 hours in all: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 30-minute conversation with the lead of the Infrastructure team, a 60-minute coding interview, a 60-minute system design interview and a closing 30-minute conversation with our VP of Engineering.

**Practicalities**
------------------

The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Paris or London office. We offer a competitive package.

Study Now runs Global Student Pathway (GSP), a production education marketplace and student-recruitment platform used daily by counsellors, admissions officers and agent partners across nine destination markets. We have just brought the platform fully in-house, and you will be the person who makes it boringly reliable: deployed safely, monitored properly, backed up provably, and secure enough to hold student visa and identity documents.

**What you’ll do**

* Assess and harden our estate across Linode and DigitalOcean, fronted by Cloudflare — topology, regions, MongoDB, storage — and own the resilience plan from day one, against defined targets: 99.9% uptime, 4-hour recovery from total provider failure (RTO), no more than 1 hour of data loss (RPO).
* Build the 3-2-1 backup regime: hourly encrypted MongoDB dumps to a second region, automatic off-provider replication, a local encrypted archive — proven by monthly restore drills, not assumed to work.
* Build and maintain CI/CD for our MEAN-stack application so releases ship with zero downtime — rolling restarts behind a load balancer, then blue-green — with the QA team’s automated suite wired in as a release gate.
* Run monitoring, alerting and incident response: uptime, error rates and performance visible at all times, with alerts reaching the right person before users notice; write and rehearse the disaster-recovery runbook.
* Own the security posture: secrets management, access control, Cloudflare WAF and rules, security-audit remediation, and UK GDPR alignment for the student data GSP holds (passports, visa documents, education records).
* Manage cloud costs across providers, report spend monthly, and evaluate consolidation or AWS-based recovery on evidence — our current position is hardened-in-place with off-provider backup.
* Document everything as runbooks usable by our two engineers without you on the call — a small team means no tribal knowledge.
  

**What we’re looking for**

* 4+ years running production infrastructure for a live web application, including at least one platform you were personally accountable for.
* Hands-on with the pieces we run: Linux servers on Linode/DigitalOcean (or similar VPS providers), Cloudflare (DNS, caching, WAF), Docker, and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or similar); infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Ansible) strongly preferred.
* MongoDB operations in production: replica sets, backups, restores and migrations under load.
* Deploying and operating Node.

**At Mako, we believe in the power of collaboration to drive innovation in pursuit of our collective ambition; excellence in trading. Our diverse community is connected through a commitment to being the best we can be with the highest standards of integrity.**

We're looking for a Platform Engineer to help design, build, and operate our on-premises Kubernetes platform running on a self-managed Linux VM fabric (KVM/libvirt-based hypervisor layer). You'll own the infrastructure that sits beneath our application workloads — from the hypervisor and VM provisioning up through Kubernetes cluster lifecycle, networking, storage, and the golden-path tooling that application teams use to ship software.

This is a hands-on, deeply technical role for someone who enjoys operating infrastructure at the systems level — not a cloud-managed-service consumer role. The VM fabric itself is still being designed and built out, so you'll have real influence over its architecture, not just its day-to-day operation. You'll be responsible for keeping the fabric and the clusters running on top of it healthy, secure, and performant, without the safety net of a hyperscaler's managed control plane.

**What you'll be involved in:**

* Design the Linux VM fabric underpinning the platform from the ground up: hypervisor architecture (KVM/libvirt), host networking topology, storage backing for VM disks, and how the fabric will scale as workload demand grows
* Operate and maintain the hypervisor layer across multiple physical hosts, including host patching, live migration/evacuation, and failure response with minimal workload disruption
* Design and maintain a distributed shared storage system such as Ceph, or an alternative
* Design and maintain VM templating and golden-image pipelines so Kubernetes nodes are provisioned consistently and can be rebuilt or rotated on demand
* Automate the VM lifecycle end-to-end — provisioning, scaling, patching, decommissioning — via infrastructure-as-code
* Manage compute, memory, and storage capacity planning across the fabric, including host-level oversubscription strategy and headroom for node failure or maintenance
* Own virtual networking within the fabric — host networking, VLANs/overlay networks — and design how it hands off cleanly into the Kubernetes CNI layer above it
* Design, build, and maintain the full lifecycle of on-prem Kubernetes clusters: bootstrapping, version upgrades, node scaling, and decommissioning, using tooling such as kubeadm, C

Someone hands-on who likes owning the stuff you can touch: switches, firewalls, servers, racks. We’re growing fast, so the infrastructure needs to grow with us, and we need someone who’s ideally already in the UAE and can get up to speed on our office, on-prem setup, and vendors from day one.

* Designing cloud network architecture and setting network requirements with the product teams
* Supporting live demos, so what we show always works
* Shaping our local GPU strategy
* Procuring physical assets, from hardware to vendors

**What makes this role different**
----------------------------------

You’ll sit between the physical and the cloud. Most infrastructure roles are one or the other; here you’ll work on both, with robots and demos depending on your work. Engineering is flat, so you’ll work directly with the engineers who rely on your setup, with no layers in between. The GPU strategy is also yours to shape.

------------------

* Solid experience with on-prem networking, firewalls, and server management
* Working knowledge of cloud networking (Azure preferred)

* Based in the UAE, with local experience
* Clear communication with engineers and non-engineers

**What we’re not looking for**

People who want a narrow, ticket-driven role, or who prefer remote-only work. You’ll be on-site, close to the hardware, and often the first person people call when something needs to work right now.

feca7fb64e772ce9.title: DevOps Engineer
feca7fb64e772ce9.description:
**About the role**

We are hiring a DevOps engineer to look after an established online learning platform. You will be responsible for the infrastructure, deployments and day-to-day reliability of a platform with real users, so the business can run with confidence and independence.

You will work alongside our existing software supplier, who will continue to look after and manage software updates. Your job is to maintain platform stability, keep documents up to date, ensure the system remains self-sufficient, and to grow into the technical anchor of the business.

**The platform**

The platform is a learning product deployed across a number of services. Expect to learn and then own:

● Cloud and data: AWS (compute, storage, networking, IAM) and MongoDB

● Media and communications: Video streaming and email

● Product tooling: Google Workspace and Jira

● Payments through Stripe

● Support on Zendesk

Part of the role is building the full picture of how it all fits together: mapping the components, documenting them, and deciding what to simplify or consolidate as the business grows.

**Responsibilities**

You own the platform being up, secure and recoverable. Feature development and larger software changes are handled by our existing software supplier, working with you.

● Reliability: keep production healthy, set up monitoring and alerting, and be the first responder when something breaks

● Infrastructure: manage AWS and MongoDB, and move manual setup into infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)

● Delivery pipelines: build and maintain CI/CD across the repositories, with repeatable and safe deployments

● Security and access: manage IAM, secrets and access to every connected service, and run joiner and leaver checks

● Backups and recovery: put in place tested backups, a documented restore process, and a basic disaster recovery plan

● Cost and hygiene: review cloud spend, remove unused resources, and keep dependencies and runtimes current

● Documentation: Maintain existing documentation and document changes as they occur

● Working with our software supplier: triage incoming issues, decide what needs a code change, and hand those over with clear context

Requirements

We care more about judgement and ownership than a specific tool list. This is a role with real ownership, so we are looking for someone who enjoys building things properly and seeing the results.

Must have

● Hands-on DevOps, SRE or platform engineering experience, including lookin
